title: Xiph.Org libFLAC 1.5.0 contains a memory leak in FLAC__stream_encoder_finish() because free_() never releases the main…
description: Xiph.Org libFLAC version 1.5.0 has a memory leak vulnerability in the function FLAC__stream_encoder_finish(). The issue arises because the free_() function does not release the main thread task's frame bit writer buffer. This can lead to memory exhaustion if an attacker submits many audio streams to a long-running service that reuses a single encoder instance.
